name: Chase Hunter
source: The protagonist of both [i]Echo[/i] and [i]Echo: Route 65[/i]. On Halloween 2008, Chase Hunter has an embarrassing encounter with his parents and must come to terms with the accidental outing of his sexuality. With the help of his friends, he attempts to avoid going back home for just one night. [Edited from [url=https://echoproject.fandom.com/wiki/Echo:_Route_65]Echo Project Wiki[/url]]
